basics.description: Deploys the **Menlo Security** connector infrastructure (Function App, Key Vault, Storage, Data Collection Endpoint, Data Collection Rule) and creates the `MenloAudit_CL`, `MenloBandwidth_CL`, and `MenloWeb_CL` custom tables in your Log Analytics workspace. **Tip:** choose **Create new** for the resource group (e.g. `MenloSecurityLogs`) so the connector can be removed in one step later. Connector resources are deployed automatically in the **same region as the selected workspace** — you do not need to match regions manually.

location.label: Resource group region
location.toolTip: Region for the resource group only. The connector resources are deployed in the same region as the selected Log Analytics workspace.

basics.name: workspaceResourceGroup
basics.label: Log Analytics Workspace Resource Group
basics.toolTip: The resource group that contains your existing Log Analytics workspace.

constraints.validationMessage: Enter the name of the resource group that contains your Log Analytics workspace.

basics.name: workspaceName
basics.label: Log Analytics Workspace
basics.toolTip: The workspace linked to your Microsoft Sentinel instance. Connector resources are deployed in this workspace's region.

options.text: Connector resources (DCE, DCR, Function App, etc.) will be deployed in the region of the selected workspace.

basics.name: menloApiToken
basics.toolTip: The API token from the Menlo Security admin console used to authenticate log retrieval.
